external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member using the library app or a self-service kiosk to borrow, renew, reserve, or return books.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who use the circulation page to administer loans and member account blocks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand

processes.name: library app
processes.description: An app on members' phones that calls the lending API for borrowing, renewal, and reservation actions.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: The REST API that is the service's interface for loan operations and reads and writes the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The Lending service note says: "The lending API is internal-only." The Interview transcript says: "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." These are conflicting positive claims, so exposure is unknown.

processes.name: self-service kiosk
processes.description: A branch kiosk where members scan their library cards and books and send loan and return events to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The single database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses, and full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The interview corrects the earlier description of two databases: "We merged those in the spring. It's one loans database now. The old reservations database is gone."

data_flows.name: borrow book
data_flows.description: A member requests a book borrowing operation through the app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: The member and book involved in a borrowing request.

data_flows.name: renew loan
data_flows.description: A member requests renewal of a loan through the app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member, and the API checks the loan rules and writes the change.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.
data_flows.data_description: The member and book identified for a loan renewal.

data_flows.name: reserve title
data_flows.description: A member requests that a title be reserved through the app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Reserving is the same shape, the app asks for a title and the API puts the member in the queue for it.
data_flows.notes: Priya said: "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look." This is a voiced uncertainty, so authentication remains unknown.
data_flows.data_description: The requested title and the member being placed in its queue.

data_flows.name: send loan
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned loan to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks send each loan and each return to the lending API.
data_flows.data_description: A member, book, and loan event scanned at the kiosk.

data_flows.name: send return
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends a scanned book return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: A member, book, and return event scanned at the kiosk.

data_flows.name: extend loan
data_flows.description: Desk staff extend a member's loan through the circulation page served by the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page; the page does not ask again and its history records only that the loan was closed by hand.
data_flows.data_description: A loan extension associated with a member account.

data_flows.name: clear account block
data_flows.description: Desk staff clear a block on a member's account through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: someone at the desk opens the circulation page and marks it returned, or clears the block on the account.
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page; the page does not ask again and its history records only that the loan was closed by hand.
data_flows.data_description: A member account block and its clearance.

data_flows.name: mark book returned
data_flows.description: Desk staff manually mark a book as returned through the circulation page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
data_flows.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login for the circulation page. The history records that the loan was closed by hand, but not which person or branch performed the action.
data_flows.data_description: A member's loan and the associated book-return status.

data_flows.name: read write records
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes member, loan, and reservation records in the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Member, loan, reservation, and borrowing-history records.

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff operate.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses, and members' full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: The Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
